docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// navigation/Navigation.kt - application screens and their permissions
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The NavHost (see Example 17) displays the current route screen, in the
// Template (top bar, menu, messages).
//
// The GARDES (see Example 18):
//    - A protected screen is wrapped by Protege(route, roles): it
//      displayed unless a user with the correct role is logged in (otherwise,
//      the 403 error screen appears);
//    - An effect monitors SESSION: a user who logs out (logout,
//      session expired) is redirected to the login screen; a user who
//      logs in leaves the login screen and proceeds to the requested screen
//      before the session expires; otherwise, to the home page for their role.
// RAPPEL: These checks are merely a CONFORT (do not display a
// unnecessary). Data protection is ensured by the server, which
// verifies the token and role for each CHAQUE request.
//
// "Flash" messages: on each new screen, Messages.nouvellePage().
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.navigation.NavDestination
import androidx.navigation.NavDestination.Companion.hasRoute
import androidx.navigation.NavHostController
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.dialog
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import androidx.navigation.toRoute
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.LocalDependances
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.Role
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageAgenda
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageConnexion
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageDemarrage
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageErreur
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageEspacePatient
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageInscription
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PageMonCompte
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PagePersonneFormulaire
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages.PagePersonnes
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets.FenetreReservation
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets.Gabarit
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

// Public screens (no login required)
fun estPublic(d: NavDestination) =
    d.hasRoute<Ecrans.Login>() || d.hasRoute<Ecrans.Inscription>() || d.hasRoute<Ecrans.Demarrage>()

// Go to a screen in the stack: The Back button will not return to the previous screen
fun NavHostController.allerA(route: Any) {
    navigate(route) {
        popUpTo(graph.id) { inclusive = true }
        launchSingleTop = true
    }
}

@Composable
fun Navigation() {
    val nav = rememberNavController()
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val session = d.session
    val utilisateur = session.utilisateur

     // Flash messages: on each new screen (a new entry in the stack)
    LaunchedEffect(nav) {
        nav.currentBackStackEntryFlow.map { it.id }.distinctUntilChanged().collect { d.messages.nouvellePage() }
    }

     // Session change: Restarted with each user change
    LaunchedEffect(utilisateur, session.verifiee) {
        if (!session.verifiee) return@LaunchedEffect
        val ici = nav.currentBackStackEntry?.destination ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        if (utilisateur == null && !estPublic(here)) {
             // session expired: save the current screen to return to it
            session.ecranDemande = if (session.departVolontaire) null else session.ecranCourant
            nav.allerA(Ecrans.Login())
        } else if (utilisateur != null && (ici.hasRoute<Ecrans.Login>() || ici.hasRoute<Ecrans.Demarrage>())) {
             // logged in: the login screen is no longer necessary
            val cible = session.ecranDemande ?: accueil(utilisateur)
            session.ecranDemande = null
            nav.allerA(cible)
        }
    }

    Gabarit(nav) {
        NavHost(navController = nav, startDestination = Ecrans.Demarrage) {
            composable<Ecrans.Demarrage> { PageDemarrage(onPersonne = { nav.allerA(Ecrans.Login()) }) }
            composable<Ecrans.Login> { e ->
                PageConnexion(login = e.toRoute<Ecrans.Login>().login.take(30), onInscription = { nav.navigate(Ecrans.Inscription) })
            }
            composable<Ecrans.Agenda> { e ->
                val route = e.toRoute<Ecrans.Agenda>()
                Protege(route) {
                    PageAgenda(
                        idMedecin = route.idMedecin,
                        jour = route.jour,
                         // view another calendar: the current path is REMPLACÉE
                        onVoir = { id, jour ->
                            nav.navigate(Ecrans.Agenda(id, jour)) { popUpTo<Ecrans.Agenda> { inclusive = true } }
                        },
                         // book: the window is EMPILÉE above the calendar
                        onReserver = { id, jour, idCreneau -> nav.navigate(Ecrans.Reservation(id, jour, idCreneau)) },
                        onMonEspace = { nav.allerA(Ecrans.MonEspace) },
                    )
                }
            }
            dialog<Ecrans.Reservation> { e ->
                val route = e.toRoute<Ecrans.Reservation>()
                Protege(route) { FenetreReservation(route, onFermer = { nav.popBackStack() }) }
            }
            composable<Ecrans.Personnes> { e ->
                val route = e.toRoute<Ecrans.Personnes>()
                Protege(route, rolesAdmin) {
                    PagePersonnes(
                        type = route.type,
                        onAjouter = { nav.navigate(Ecrans.Personne(route.type)) },
                        onModifier = { id -> nav.navigate(Ecrans.Personne(route.type, id)) },
                    )
                }
            }
            composable<Ecrans.Personne> { e ->
                val route = e.toRoute<Ecrans.Personne>()
                Protege(route, rolesAdmin) {
                     // Back to the list: close the form
                    PagePersonneFormulaire(type = route.type, id = route.id, onListe = {
                        if (!nav.popBackStack()) nav.allerA(Ecrans.Personnes(route.type))
                    })
                }
            }
            composable<Ecrans.Inscription> {
                PageInscription(onConnexion = { login -> nav.allerA(Ecrans.Login(login)) })
            }
            composable<Ecrans.MonEspace> {
                Protege(Ecrans.MonEspace, rolesPatient) {
                    PageEspacePatient(
                        onMonCompte = { nav.navigate(Ecrans.MonCompte) },
                        onAgenda = { id, jour -> nav.navigate(Ecrans.Agenda(id, jour)) },
                    )
                }
            }
            composable<Ecrans.MonCompte> {
                Protege(Ecrans.MonCompte, rolesPatient) {
                    PageMonCompte(onMonEspace = { nav.allerA(Ecrans.MonEspace) })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// a protected screen: logged in, and, if roles is not null, with one of these roles
@Composable
fun Protege(route: Any, roles: Set<Role>? = null, contenu: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val session = LocalDependances.current.session
    val u = session.utilisateur ?: return // not logged in: navigation redirects to the login page
     // the currently displayed screen, saved to return to after a session expires
    LaunchedEffect(route) { session.ecranCourant = route }
    if (roles != null && u.role !in roles) {
        PageErreur(code = 403)
    } else {
        contenu()
    }
}

  • lines 69–70: Flash messages: [currentBackStackEntryFlow], [Flow] for successive screens;
  • lines 74–85: LE application guard: an effect that is triggered each time the user changes. If no one is on a protected screen: upon login (retaining the current screen if the session has expired); if someone is on the login screen: to the requested screen, otherwise to the home screen for their role;
  • lines 89–113: the navigation graph, in the template; [dialog<Ecrans.Reservation>]: a destination displayed; PAR-DESSUS: the previous screen, which the Back button closes;
  • lines 156–164: [Protege]: not logged in, nothing (the effect above refers to the login); incorrect role, the 403 error screen.

// a menu item: the path it leads to, the key for its label, its
// icon, and the flag indicating whether it is active for a given screen
class EntreeMenu(val route: Any, val cle: String, val icone: ImageVector, val active: (NavDestination, Any?) -> Boolean)

fun entreesMenu(u: Utilisateur?): List<EntreeMenu> {
    if (u == null) return emptyList()
     // buildList: we populate a list using if statements
    return buildList {
        if (u.estPatient) add(EntreeMenu(Ecrans.MonEspace, "APP.MENU_MY_SPACE", Icons.Default.Home) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Ecrans.MonEspace>() })
        add(EntreeMenu(Ecrans.Agenda(), "APP.MENU_AGENDA", Icons.Default.DateRange) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Ecrans.Agenda>() })
        if (u.estAdmin) {
            add(EntreeMenu(Ecrans.Personnes(TypePersonnes.MEDECINS), "APP.MENU_DOCTORS", Icons.Default.Face) { _, type -> type == TypePersonnes.MEDECINS })
            add(EntreeMenu(Ecrans.Personnes(TypePersonnes.CLIENTS), "APP.MENU_PATIENTS", Icons.Default.Person) { _, type -> type == TypePersonnes.CLIENTS })
        }
        if (u.estPatient) add(EntreeMenu(Ecrans.MonCompte, "APP.MENU_ACCOUNT", Icons.Default.AccountCircle) { d, _ -> d.hasRoute<Ecrans.MonCompte>() })
    }
}

@Composable
fun Gabarit(nav: NavHostController, contenu: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val u = d.session.utilisateur
    val langue = LocalTraductions.current.langue
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val entrees = entreesMenu(u)
     // the current screen, and the type of element—whether it’s a list or a form
    val entree by nav.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
    val destination = entree?.destination
    val type: TypePersonnes? = when {
        destination?.hasRoute<Ecrans.Personnes>() == true -> entree?.toRoute<Ecrans.Personnes>()?.type
        destination?.hasRoute<Ecrans.Personne>() == true -> entree?.toRoute<Ecrans.Personne>()?.type
        else -> null
    }
    fun estActive(e: EntreeMenu) = destination != null && e.active(destination, type)
     // a large screen: at least 800 dp wide
    val grandEcran = LocalConfiguration.current.screenWidthDp >= 800
    val tiroir = rememberDrawerState(DrawerValue.Closed)
    var menuLangue by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val page = @Composable {
        Scaffold(
            topBar = {
                TopAppBar(
                    title = { Text(t("APP.TITLE")) },
                    navigationIcon = {
                        if (u != null && !grandEcran) {
                            IconButton(onClick = { portee.launch { tiroir.open() } }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Menu, contentDescription = "menu") }
                        }
                    },
                    colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        titleContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                        navigationIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                        actionIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                    ),
                    actions = {
                         // FR / EN: a menu; the activity is recreated in the new language
                        TextButton(onClick = { menuLangue = true }) {
                            Text(langue.uppercase(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                        DropdownMenu(expanded = menuLangue, onDismissRequest = { menuLangue = false }) {
                            for (l in langues) {
                                DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(l.uppercase()) }, onClick = {
                                    menuLangue = false
                                    changerLangue(l)
                                })
                            }
                        }
                        if (u != null) {
                             // The session is closing; the browser, which is monitoring it, displays the login screen
                            IconButton(onClick = { portee.launch { runCatching { d.session.deconnecter() } } }) {
                                Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ExitToApp, contentDescription = t("APP.LOGOUT"))
                            }
                        }
                    },
                )
            },
        ) { marges ->
            Row(Modifier.padding(marges).consumeWindowInsets(marges).fillMaxSize()) {
                 // on a large screen: the menu, which is always
                if (u != null && grandEcran) {
                    NavigationRail {
                        for (e in entrees) {
                            NavigationRailItem(
                                selected = estActive(e),
                                onClick = { nav.allerA(e.route) },
                                icon = { Icon(e.icone, contentDescription = null) },
                                label = { Text(t(e.cle)) },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    VerticalDivider()
                }
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxSize().imePadding()) {
                    MessageSucces()
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) { contenu() }
                    ZoneErreur()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (u == null || grandEcran) {
        page()
    } else {
         // the drawer: only when logged in, and only on a small screen
        ModalNavigationDrawer(
            drawerState = tiroir,
            drawerContent = {
                ModalDrawerSheet {
                     // the header: who is logged in
                    Column(Modifier.padding(start = 28.dp, top = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, bottom = 10.dp)) {
                        Text(u.nom, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                        SuggestionChip(onClick = {}, label = { Text(u.role.name) })
                    }
                    for (e in entrees) {
                        NavigationDrawerItem(
                            label = { Text(t(e.cle)) },
                            icon = { Icon(e.icone, contentDescription = null) },
                            selected = estActive(e),
                            onClick = {
                                portee.launch { tiroir.close() }
                                nav.allerA(e.route)
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                        )
                    }
                }
            },
        ) { page() }
    }
}

// the success message, at the top
@Composable
private fun MessageSucces() {
    val messages = LocalDependances.current.messages
    val succes = messages.succes ?: return
    ListItem(
        colors = ListItemDefaults.colors(containerColor = Color(0xFFE8F5E9)),
        leadingContent = { Icon(Icons.Default.CheckCircle, contentDescription = null, tint = Color(0xFF2E7D32)) },
        headlineContent = { Text(t(succes.cle, succes.params), color = Color(0xFF1B5E20)) },
        trailingContent = { IconButton(onClick = { messages.effacer() }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Close, contentDescription = null) } },
    )
}

// the error area, at the bottom: always visible, even when scrolling
@Composable
private fun ZoneErreur() {
    val messages = LocalDependances.current.messages
    val erreur = messages.erreur ?: return
    ListItem(
        colors = ListItemDefaults.colors(containerColor = Color(0xFFF8D7DA)),
        leadingContent = { Icon(Icons.Default.Warning, contentDescription = null, tint = Color(0xFFC62828)) },
        headlineContent = { Text(t(erreur.cle, erreur.params), color = Color(0xFFB71C1C)) },
        trailingContent = { IconButton(onClick = { messages.effacer() }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Close, contentDescription = null) } },
    )
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Label + field + tooltip OU error message. All
// forms in the application use it:
//
//    ChampSaisie (label = "PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL", longueurMax = 20,
//                value = entered["nom"], onChange = { modify("name", it) },
//                error = send.errors["nom"])
//
// This is a CONTRÔLÉ component (see Example 11): the value belongs to the
// parent form. Label, help, and error are translation CLÉS;
// "params," the parameters for their messages ({{min}}...).
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.PasswordVisualTransformation
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.VisualTransformation
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.i18n.t

@Composable
fun ChampSaisie(
    libelle: String,
    valeur: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    erreur: String? = null,
    aide: String? = null,
    params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    secret: Boolean = false, // a password: masked characters
    longueurMax: Int? = null,
     // for the phone's password manager (username, password...)
    typeContenu: ContentType? = null,
) {
    val messageErreur = erreur?.let { t(it, params) }
    val messageAide = aide?.let { t(it, params) }
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = valeur,
         // the field rejects extra characters
        onValueChange = { v -> if (longueurMax == null || v.length <= longueurMax) onChange(v) },
        label = { Text(t(libelle)) },
        singleLine = true,
        isError = messageErreur != null,
         // error, otherwise help
        supportingText = (messageErreur ?: messageAide)?.let { m -> { Text(m) } },
        visualTransformation = if (secret) PasswordVisualTransformation() else VisualTransformation.None,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = if (secret) KeyboardType.Password else KeyboardType.Text),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(bottom = 4.dp)
            .semantics { if (typeContenu != null) contentType = typeContenu },
    )
}

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// widgets/EnvoiFormulaire.kt - send a form to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All forms in the application follow the same pattern as
// Example 25: no rules are checked on the phone (they reside
// in a single location—the server—and in case of rejection:
//    - the error for each field (ErreurApi.champs) is displayed below the field;
//    - the general message (ErreurApi.cle) appears at the bottom of the screen.
// This class groups these actions (it is the Command from Example 23,
// supplemented with field errors). A screen creates one per form:
//
//      submit_val = remember { EnvoiFormulaire(messages) }
//      if (envoi.envoyer { api.inscrire(input) }) { ... }
//      ChampSaisie(..., error = send.errors["nom"])
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.ErreurApi
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.etat.Messages

class EnvoiFormulaire(private val messages: Messages) {
     // the error for each field: a CLÉ translation
    var erreurs by mutableStateOf(mapOf<String, String>())
        private set

     // error message parameters ({{min}}...), returned by the server
    var params by mutableStateOf(mapOf<String, String>())
        private set
    var enCours by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

     // executes the send; returns true if successful. In case of ErreurApi, the
     // errors are displayed and false is returned
    suspend fun envoyer(action: suspend () -> Unit): Boolean {
        if (enCours) return false // no duplicate submission
        erreurs = emptyMap()
        params = emptyMap()
        enCours = true
        try {
            action()
            return true
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
            erreurs = e.champs
            params = e.params
            return false
        } finally {
            enCours = false
        }
    }

     // the user modifies a field: the error disappears
    fun effacerErreur(champ: String) {
        if (champ in erreurs) erreurs = erreurs - champ
    }
}

The [Commande] from Example 23, with field errors added: all forms in the application use it.

// =========================================================================
// widgets/Confirmation.kt - “Are you sure?”
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Taken from Example 16. The message is a translation CLÉ:
//      if (confirmation.confirmer("AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) { ... }
// "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes “Cancel this
// appointment?", and a "Cancel" button would be ambiguous in this context.
// A new question clears the messages from the previous action.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.ButtonDefaults
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.etat.Messages
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.i18n.t
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred

class Confirmation(private val messages: Messages) {
    var question by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set
    private var reponse: CompletableDeferred<Boolean>? = null

    suspend fun confirmer(cle: String): Boolean {
        messages.effacer()
        val attente = CompletableDeferred<Boolean>()
        reponse = attente
        question = cle
        try {
            return attente.await()
        } finally {
            question = null
        }
    }

    fun repondre(oui: Boolean) {
        reponse?.complete(oui)
    }
}

@Composable
fun rememberConfirmation(messages: Messages): Confirmation = remember { Confirmation(messages) }

@Composable
fun FenetreConfirmation(confirmation: Confirmation) {
    val cle = confirmation.question ?: return
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { confirmation.repondre(false) },
        title = { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.TITLE")) },
        text = { Text(t(cle)) },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { confirmation.repondre(false) }) { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.NO")) } },
        confirmButton = {
            Button(
                onClick = { confirmation.repondre(true) },
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFC62828)),
            ) { Text(t("CONFIRMATION.YES")) }
        },
    )
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/ImageSvg.kt (taken from the examples, common/ImageSvg.kt) - render a given SVG image as text
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The CAPTCHA image is generated by the server in the format SVG (a text
// that describes a drawing). Android cannot display it on its own: the
// AndroidSVG library renders it as an image (a Bitmap), which
// Compose displays it using the Image component.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.asImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.caverock.androidsvg.SVG

@Composable
fun ImageSvg(svg: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, hauteur: Dp = 50.dp, description: String? = null) {
     // The drawing is redrawn only if the text SVG changes (remember(svg))
    val image = remember(svg) {
        val document = SVG.getFromString(svg)
         // drawn three times larger than its “natural” size: a sharp image
        val echelle = 3f
        val largeur = (document.documentWidth.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 150f)
        val haut = (document.documentHeight.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 50f)
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap((largeur * echelle).toInt(), (haut * echelle).toInt(), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val toile = Canvas(bitmap)
        toile.scale(echelle, echelle)
        document.renderToCanvas(toile)
        bitmap.asImageBitmap()
    }
    Image(image, contentDescription = description, contentScale = ContentScale.Fit, modifier = modifier.height(hauteur))
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/ListeDeroulante.kt (taken from the examples, common/ListeDeroulante.kt) — a drop-down list, ready to use
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Material 3 for Compose does not have a standalone "drop-down list" component
// on its own: it is assembled from three elements—ExposedDropdownMenuBox,
// a read-only text field, and the menu ExposedDropdownMenu. We
// do it here once and for all (examples 05 through 08, 24, 25):
//
//      ListeDeroulante("Country", value = country, options = listOf("fr", "be", "ch"),
//                      text = { countryNames[it] }, onChange = { country = it })
//
// The function is GÉNÉRIQUE (<T>): the choices can be strings,
// numbers, doctors... The text specifies how AFFICHER a choice is represented. A choice
// can be null ("-- select --") if T is a "nullable" type (Int?).
// =========================================================================
@file:OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)

package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenuItem
import androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api
import androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType
import androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox
import androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier

@Composable
fun <T> ListeDeroulante(
    libelle: String,
    valeur: T,
    choix: List<T>,
    onChange: (T) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    texte: (T) -> String = { it.toString() },
     // an error message below the field (see examples 07 and 25)
    erreur: String? = null,
) {
     // Is the menu open? A status PROPRE for each drop-down list
    var ouvert by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    ExposedDropdownMenuBox(expanded = ouvert, onExpandedChange = { ouvert = it }, modifier = modifier) {
         // the field displaying the current selection; menuAnchor actually serves as the
         // menu anchor (tapping opens the menu)
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = texte(valeur),
            onValueChange = {},
            readOnly = true,
            singleLine = true,
            label = { Text(libelle) },
            trailingIcon = { ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults.TrailingIcon(expanded = ouvert) },
            isError = erreur != null,
            supportingText = if (erreur == null) null else { { Text(erreur) } },
            modifier = Modifier.menuAnchor(ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType.PrimaryNotEditable).fillMaxWidth(),
        )
         // the menu: one line per option
        ExposedDropdownMenu(expanded = ouvert, onDismissRequest = { ouvert = false }) {
            for (c in choix) {
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text(texte(c)) },
                    onClick = {
                        onChange(c)
                        ouvert = false
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// widgets/FenetreReservation.kt - the slot reservation window
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A "dialog" navigation destination (Ecrans.Reservation):
// It displays PAR-DESSUS the calendar, including the grayed-out background, and the button
// "Back" button on the phone closes it. The path contains everything he needs:
// the doctor, the day, the time slot.
// She reviews the calendar in the CACHE (no query: the calendar has just been
// read) to find the time slot and verify that it’s available for booking.
// After the booking: a pop-up message, the window closes, and the entry
// of the cache; the calendar, which remains active in the background, refreshes automatically.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.widgets

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement

import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun FenetreReservation(route: Ecrans.Reservation, onFermer: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val u = d.session.utilisateur
    var creneau by remember { mutableStateOf<CreneauAgenda?>(null) }
     // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
    var clients by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Personne>()) }
    var idClient by remember { mutableStateOf<Int?>(null) }
    var envoiEnCours by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        try {
            val agenda = d.cache.lire(cleAgenda(route.idMedecin, route.jour)) { d.api.agenda(route.idMedecin, route.jour) }
             // only if this time slot is bookable by this user
            creneau = agenda.creneaux.find { it.id == route.idCreneau && it.reservable }
            if (creneau == null) onFermer()
            if (u.estGestionnaire) clients = d.cache.lire("clients") { d.api.lister(TypePersonnes.CLIENTS) }
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
        }
    }

    fun confirmer() {
        val c = creneau ?: return
        portee.launch {
            envoiEnCours = true
            try {
                d.api.reserver(route.jour, c.id, if (u.estGestionnaire) idClient else null)
                d.messages.flash("AGENDA.BOOKED")
            } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
                if (e.cle == "ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT") {
                     // No patient selected: the window remains open
                    d.messages.afficherErreur(e.cle)
                    envoiEnCours = false
                    return@launch
                }
                 // slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment...:
                 // the message will appear on the calendar; window closed
                d.messages.flash(e.cle, e.params, succes = false)
            }
            envoiEnCours = false
            onFermer()
             // the server’s record takes precedence: the calendar (and the patient’s profile) will be re-checked
            d.cache.invalider("mon-espace")
            d.cache.invalider("agenda")
        }
    }

    val c = creneau ?: return
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
            Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT", mapOf("horaire" to horaire(c))))
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            if (u.estPatient) {
                 // A patient books an appointment for themselves: no list (and the server
                 // would ignore any potential idClient anyway)
                Text(
                    buildAnnotatedString {
                        append("${t("BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL")} : ")
                        withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)) { append(u?.nom ?: "") }
                    },
                )
            } else {
                val invite = t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT")
                ListeDeroulante(
                    libelle = t("BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL"),
                    valeur = idClient,
                    choix = listOf<Int?>(null) + clients.map { it.id },
                    texte = { i -> clients.find { it.id == i }?.libelle ?: invite },
                    onChange = { idClient = it },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
             // An error (no patient selected): the error area on the screen is
             // hidden beneath the window; we repeat it here
            d.messages.erreur?.let { m ->
                Text(t(m.cle, m.params), color = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color(0xFFC62828), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp, androidx.compose.ui.Alignment.End)) {
                TextButton(onClick = onFermer) { Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL")) }
                Button(onClick = { confirmer() }, enabled = !envoiEnCours) { Text(t("BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM")) }
            }
        }
    }
}

  • lines 76–98: the reservation: a pop-up message, closing the window, and invalidating the cache; the calendar, which remains active beneath the window, reloads automatically.

// before allowing the account creation process to begin.

import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun PageConnexion(login: String, onInscription: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val envoi = remember { EnvoiFormulaire(d.messages) }
     // data entry: a Map, field -> value; rememberSaveable: it survives a
     // language change (the activity is recreated)
    var saisie by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(mapOf("login" to login, "password" to "", "captcha" to "")) }
    var captcha by remember { mutableStateOf<Captcha?>(null) }
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()

     // a new image: this is necessary after CHAQUE attempt, because an image is not
     // is only used UNE times (the server forgets it as soon as it has verified it)
    suspend fun rechargerCaptcha() {
        captcha = try {
            d.api.captcha()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null // server unreachable: the connection will fail with a clear message
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { rechargerCaptcha() }

    fun modifier(champ: String, valeur: String) {
        saisie = saisie + (champ to valeur)
        envoi.effacerErreur(champ)
    }

     // Both buttons follow this sequence: send, then, in case of
     // a failure, an error message and NOUVELLE image
    fun tenter(action: suspend () -> Unit) {
        portee.launch {
            d.messages.effacer()
            if (!envoi.envoyer(action)) {
                saisie = saisie + ("captcha" to "")
                rechargerCaptcha()
            }
        }
    }

     // if successful, nothing else to do here: the navigation switches screens
    fun seConnecter() = tenter {
        d.session.connecter(saisie.getValue("login").trim(), saisie.getValue("password"), captcha?.id ?: "", saisie.getValue("captcha"))
    }

    fun creerCompte() = tenter {
        d.api.accesInscription(captcha?.id ?: "", saisie.getValue("captcha"))
        onInscription()
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(t("LOGIN.TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
         // typeContenu: the phone’s password manager can fill out the form
        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL",
            valeur = saisie.getValue("login"),
            onChange = { modifier("login", it) },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["login"],
            typeContenu = ContentType.Username,
        )
        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            valeur = saisie.getValue("password"),
            onChange = { modifier("password", it) },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["password"],
            typeContenu = ContentType.Password,
        )
        ChampCaptcha(
            svg = captcha?.svg,
            valeur = saisie.getValue("captcha"),
            onChange = { modifier("captcha", it) },
            onRecharger = { portee.launch { rechargerCaptcha() } },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["captcha"],
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Button(onClick = { seConnecter() }, enabled = !envoi.enCours, modify = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text(t("LOGIN.SUBMIT")) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        OutlinedButton(onClick = { creerCompte() }, enabled = !envoi.enCours, modified = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Text(t("LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT"))
        }
        Text(
            t("LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP"),
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 4.dp),
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        ComptesDemo()
    }
}

// demo accounts
@Composable
private fun ComptesDemo() {
    val style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall
    Text(t("LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS"), style = style, color = Color.DarkGray)
    for ((comptes, cle) in listOf(
        "admin" to "LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN",
        "pelissier, tatou, dupont" to "LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR",
        "martin, durand, bistrou, german" to "LOGIN.DEMO_USER",
    )) {
        Text(
            buildAnnotatedString {
                append("• ")
                withStyle(SpanStyle(fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)) { append(comptes) }
                append(" - ${t(cle)}")
            },
            style = style,
            color = Color.DarkGray,
        )
    }
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/PageAgenda.kt - the calendar screen
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three sections, as in other clients:
//    1. Selecting the doctor and the day;
//    2. that doctor’s schedule for that day;
//    3. the appointment booking window: a different approach,
//       Ecrans.Reservation, displayed on top (see FenetreReservation.kt).
//
// TOUT The screen status is in its ROUTE: Ecrans.Agenda (idMedecin, day).
// The screen in DÉDUIT shows what it displays, and the user’s actions
// change the route (onVoir, onReserver); the phone’s Back button
// closes the booking window.
//
// What each user sees and can do is determined by the SERVEUR (fields
// patient, me, bookable, idRv fields for each time slot): the screen simply
// displaying it. A patient does not even see the names of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

// the key for a doctor’s schedule on a given day, in the cache
fun cleAgenda(idMedecin: Int?, jour: String) = "agenda/$idMedecin/$jour"

@Composable
fun PageAgenda(
    idMedecin: Int?,
    jour: String?, // as-is in the route: possibly invalid
    onVoir: (Int?, String) -> Unit,
    onReserver: (Int?, String, Int) -> Unit,
    onMonEspace: () -> Unit,
) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val utilisateur = d.session.utilisateur
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()
     // the day: the one from the route if it is valid, otherwise today
    val jourInvalide = jour != null && !estUneDateValide(day)
    val leJour = if (jour != null && !jourInvalide) day else today()

    var medecins by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Personne>()) }
     // the calendar (null until it arrives, or if there isn't one)
    var agenda by remember { mutableStateOf<Agenda?>(null) }
    var chargement by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

     // doctors: read once (cache); an error is displayed at the bottom of the screen
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        try {
            medecins = d.cache.lire("medecins") { d.api.lister(TypePersonnes.MEDECINS) }
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
        }
        if (jourInvalide) d.messages.afficherErreur("ERRORS.INVALID_DATE")
    }

     // the schedule: re-read if the route changes (different doctor, different day) or if the
     // cache is invalidated (appointment, cancellation: d.cache.version changes).
     // If there is no doctor on the route, a DOCTOR sees the SON schedule (the server
     // retrieves it from the token); the others see nothing
    val avecAgenda = !jourInvalide && (idMedecin != null || user?.role == Role.DOCTOR)
    LaunchedEffect(idMedecin, leJour, d.cache.version) {
        if (!avecAgenda) {
            agenda = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        chargement = true
        try {
            agenda = d.cache.lire(cleAgenda(idMedecin, leJour)) { d.api.agenda(idMedecin, leJour) }
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            agenda = null
            d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
        }
        chargement = false
    }

     // The server's version is authoritative: after a cancellation, the calendar is re-read
     // (and the patient’s dashboard, which displays their appointment)
    fun annuler(c: CreneauAgenda) {
        val idRv = c.idRv ?: return
        portee.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirmer("AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.annulerRv(idRv)
                d.messages.afficherSucces("AGENDA.CANCELLED")
            } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
                d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
            }
            d.cache.invalider("mon-espace")
            d.cache.invalider("agenda")
        }
    }

    val a = agenda
     // The displayed doctor: the one from the route, or the one from the received schedule (DOCTOR)
    val idAffiche = idMedecin ?: a?.medecin?.id
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(12.dp)) {
         // 1. Selection of the doctor and the day. Key: If the route changes, the
         // form is recreated and resets to the new values
        androidx.compose.runtime.key(idAffiche, leJour) {
            ChoixMedecinJour(medecins = medecins, idMedecin = idAffiche, jour = leJour, onVoir = onVoir)
        }
         // Patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button
        a?.info?.let { info ->
            Card(colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFE1F5FE)), modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp)) {
                ListItem(
                    colors = androidx.compose.material3.ListItemDefaults.colors(containerColor = Color.Transparent),
                    headlineContent = { Text(t(info)) },
                    trailingContent = { TextButton(onClick = onMonEspace) { Text(t("APP.MENU_MY_SPACE")) } },
                )
            }
        }

        when {

@Composable
private fun ChoixMedecinJour(medecins: List<Personne>, idMedecin: Int?, jour: String, onVoir: (Int?, String) -> Unit) {
    var id by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(idMedecin) }
    var leJour by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(jour) }
    var calendrier by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val langue = LocalTraductions.current.langue
     // The selected doctor must be on the list (otherwise: none)
    val idConnu = id.takeIf { i -> medecins.any { it.id == i } }
     // t() is a @Composable function: we translate AVANT the text lambda, which isn’t actually a lambda
    val invite = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR")
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
            ListeDeroulante(
                libelle = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL"),
                valeur = idConnu,
                choix = listOf<Int?>(null) + medecins.map { it.id },
                texte = { i -> medecins.find { it.id == i }?.libelle ?: invite },
                onChange = { id = it },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
             // The day: a read-only field; tapping opens the calendar
            Box {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = jourLong(leJour, langue),
                    onValueChange = {},
                    readOnly = true,
                    label = { Text(t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL")) },
                    trailingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Default.DateRange, contentDescription = t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DAY")) },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                 // A transparent overlay on top of the field that handles the tap
                Box(Modifier.matchParentSize().clickable { calendrier = true })
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Button(onClick = { onVoir(idConnu, leJour) }, enabled = idConnu != null, edit = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Text(t("DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA"))
            }
        }
    }
    if (calendrier) {
        val etat = rememberDatePickerState(initialSelectedDateMillis = versMillis(leJour))
        DatePickerDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { calendrier = false },
             // the Android "Cancel" text (OK), in the app's language
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    etat.selectedDateMillis?.let { leJour = depuisMillis(it) }
                    calendrier = false
                }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.ok)) }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { calendrier = false }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) } },
        ) { DatePicker(state = etat) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun PageEspacePatient(onMonCompte: () -> Unit, onAgenda: (Int?, String?) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val langue = LocalTraductions.current.langue
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var espace by remember { mutableStateOf<MonEspace?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(d.cache.version) {
        try {
            espace = d.cache.lire("mon-espace") { d.api.monEspace() }
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
        }
    }

    fun annuler(idRv: Int) {
        portee.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirmer("AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM")) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.annulerRv(idRv)
                d.messages.afficherSucces("AGENDA.CANCELLED")
            } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
                d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
            }
             // The ET calendars have changed
            d.cache.invalider("mon-espace")
            d.cache.invalider("agenda")
        }
    }

    val e = espace
    if (e == null) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator() }
        return
    }
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(12.dp)) {
        Text(t("ESPACE.HELLO", mapOf("nom" to e.patient.libelle)), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(4.dp))
        Option(Icons.Default.AccountCircle, t("ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT"), t("ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP"), onMonCompte)
        Option(Icons.Default.DateRange, t("ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA"), t("ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA_HELP")) { onAgenda(null, null) }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
                Text(t("ESPACE.MY_APPOINTMENT"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                 // Normally just one (rule: "one upcoming appointment at a time"),
                 // but the screen can display several
                for (rv in e.rendezVous) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text("${jourLong(rv.jour, langue)}, ${horaire(rv.creneau)}", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                    Text(rv.medecin.libelle)
                    FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                         // the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there
                        TextButton(onClick = { onAgenda(rv.medecin.id, rv.jour) }) { Text(t("ESPACE.SEE_IN_AGENDA")) }
                        OutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { annuler(rv.id) },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = Color(0xFFC62828)),
                        ) { Text(t("ESPACE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT")) }
                    }
                }
                if (e.rendezVous.isEmpty()) Text(t("ESPACE.NO_APPOINTMENT"), color = Color.Gray, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
            }
        }
    }
    FenetreConfirmation(confirmation)
}

// =========================================================================
// pages/PersonnesConfig.kt—doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The screens for managing doctors and clients are IDENTIQUES: same
// list, same form. They are called UNE times (PagePersonnes.kt,
// PagePersonneFormulaire.kt); the only things that change are the API address and the
// label keys, described here. The script passes the type to each screen.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.pages

import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.Personne
import fr.stahe.rdvmedecins.api.TypePersonnes

data class ClesPersonnes(
    val titre: String, // "Doctors"
    val ajouter: String, // "Add a doctor"
    val modifier: String, // "Edit a doctor"
    val vide: String, // "No doctors."
    val confirmerSuppression: String,
    val ajoute: String, // "The doctor {{name}} has been added (login: {{login}})."
    val modifie: String,
    val supprime: String,
    val introuvable: String, // The record has been deleted in the meantime
)

// keys of a type: a single entry, using the prefix "MEDECINS." or "CLIENTS."
fun cles(type: TypePersonnes): ClesPersonnes {
    val p = if (type == TypePersonnes.MEDECINS) "MEDECINS" else "CLIENTS"
    return ClesPersonnes(
        titre = "$p.TITLE",
        ajouter = "$p.ADD",
        modifier = "$p.EDIT",
        vide = "$p.EMPTY",
        confirmerSuppression = "$p.DELETE_CONFIRM",
        ajoute = "$p.ADDED",
        modifie = "$p.UPDATED",
        supprime = "$p.DELETED",
        introuvable = if (type == TypePersonnes.MEDECINS) "ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND" else "ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND",
    )
}

// {{name}} and {{login}} for "added / modified / deleted" messages
fun parametres(p: Personne) = mapOf("nom" to "${p.prenom} ${p.nom}", "login" to (p.login ?: ""))

@Composable
fun PagePersonnes(type: TypePersonnes, onAjouter: () -> Unit, onModifier: (Int) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val c = cles(type)
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()
     // null: not yet loaded
    var liste by remember(type) { mutableStateOf<List<Personne>?>(null) }
    var echec by remember(type) { mutableStateOf(false) }

     // re-read if the type changes or if the cache is invalidated
    LaunchedEffect(type, d.cache.version) {
        try {
            liste = d.cache.lire(type.chemin) { d.api.lister(type) }
        } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
            echec = true
            d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
        }
    }

    fun supprimer(p: Personne) {
        portee.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirmer(c.confirmerSuppression)) return@launch
            try {
                d.api.supprimer(type, p.id)
                d.messages.afficherSucces(c.supprime, parametres(p))
            } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
                 // a doctor who still has available appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
                d.messages.afficherErreurApi(e)
            }
            d.cache.invalider(type.chemin)
        }
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val l = liste
        if (l == null) {
             // not yet loaded (or loading failed: the message is at the bottom of the screen)
            if (!(failure) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.align(Alignment.Center))
        } else {
             // space at the bottom, so as not to hide the last line under the floating button
            LazyColumn(contentPadding = PaddingValues(start = 8.dp, top = 8.dp, end = 8.dp, bottom = 88.dp)) {
                item { Text(t(c.titre), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp)) }
                if (l.isEmpty()) item { ListItem(headlineContent = { Text(t(c.vide)) }) }
                 // one line per person; key: the line’s ID
                items(l, key = { it.id }) { p ->
                    Card(Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp)) {
                        ListItem(
                            leadingContent = {
                                Box(Modifier.size(40.dp).background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer, CircleShape), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                    Text("${p.prenom.first()}${p.nom.first()}")
                                }
                            },
                            headlineContent = { Text(p.libelle) },
                            supportingContent = { Text(p.login ?: "", fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace) },
                            trailingContent = {
                                Row {
                                    IconButton(onClick = { onModifier(p.id) }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Edit, contentDescription = t("PERSONNES.EDIT")) }
                                    IconButton(onClick = { supprimer(p) }) {
                                        Icon(Icons.Outlined.Delete, contentDescription = t("PERSONNES.DELETE"), tint = Color(0xFFC62828))
                                    }
                                }
                            },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ExtendedFloatingActionButton(
            onClick = onAjouter,
            icon = { Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = null) },
            text = { Text(t(c.ajouter)) },
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).padding(16.dp),
        )
    }
    FenetreConfirmation(confirmation)
}

private val vide = mapOf("titre" to "Mr", "prenom" to "", "nom" to "", "login" to "", "password" to "")

@Composable
fun PagePersonneFormulaire(type: TypePersonnes, id: Int?, onListe: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
     // the initial values: empty (creation), or those of the read record
    var initial by remember { mutableStateOf<Donnees?>(if (id == null) vide else null) }

    if (id != null) {
        LaunchedEffect(id) {
            try {
                 // SANS cache: the record must be up to date (otherwise the form
                 // would start with an outdated version: 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE)
                val p = d.api.lire(type, id)
                initial = mapOf("titre" to p.titre, "prenom" to p.prenom, "nom" to p.nom, "login" to (p.login ?: ""), "password" to "", "version" to p.version)
            } catch (e: ErreurApi) {
                 // record does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): return to the list
                d.messages.flash(e.cle, e.params, succes = false)
                onListe()
            }
        }
    }
    val depart = initial
    if (depart == null) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { CircularProgressIndicator() }
    } else {
        Formulaire(type, id, depart, onListe)
    }
}

// the form itself
@Composable
private fun Formulaire(type: TypePersonnes, id: Int?, initial: Donnees, onListe: () -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val c = cles(type)
    val creation = id == null
    val envoi = remember { EnvoiFormulaire(d.messages) }
     // an editable COPIE with default values
    var saisie by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(initial) }
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()

    fun modifier(champ: String, valeur: String) {
        saisie = saisie + (champ to valeur)
        envoi.effacerErreur(champ)
    }

    fun enregistrer() {
        portee.launch {
            val reussi = envoi.envoyer {
                val p = if (id == null) d.api.ajouter(type, saisie) else d.api.modifier(type, id, saisie)
                d.messages.flash(if (creation) c.ajoute else c.modifie, parametres(p))
            }
            val cle = d.messages.erreur?.cle
            if (reussi) {
                d.cache.invalider(type.chemin) // the list has changed
                onListe()
            } else if (cle == c.introuvable) {
                 // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
                d.messages.flash(cle, succes = false)
                onListe()
            }
        }
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(t(if (creation) c.ajouter else c.modifier), style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        ChampsPersonne(valeurs = saisie, erreurs = envoi.erreurs, onChange = ::modifier)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text(t("PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL",
            longueurMax = 30,
            valeur = saisie["login"] as String,
            onChange = { modifier("login", it) },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["login"],
            aide = if (creation) "PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE" else "PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT",
        )
         // never pre-filled: the password is never returned from the server
        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            longueurMax = 72,
            valeur = saisie["password"] as String,
            onChange = { modifier("password", it) },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["password"],
            params = envoi.params,
            aide = if (creation) "PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE" else "PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT",
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Button(onClick = { enregistrer() }, enabled = !envoi.enCours) { Text(t("PERSONNES.SAVE")) }
            OutlinedButton(onClick = onListe) { Text(t("PERSONNES.BACK")) }
        }
    }

@Composable
fun PageInscription(onConnexion: (String) -> Unit) {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val envoi = remember { EnvoiFormulaire(d.messages) }
    var saisie by rememberSaveable {
        mutableStateOf(mapOf("titre" to "Mr", "prenom" to "", "nom" to "", "login" to "", "password" to "", "confirmation" to ""))
    }
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()

     // the PROPRE token on this screen: without a pass, return to the login screen
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val valide = runCatching { d.api.etatAccesInscription() }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!valid) {
            d.messages.flash("ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT", succes = false)

                 // return to the login screen, login pre-filled
                d.messages.flash("INSCRIPTION.DONE", mapOf("login" to login))
                onConnexion(login)
            } else if (d.messages.erreur?.cle == "ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT") {
                 // Password expired (15 minutes): return to CAPTCHA
                d.messages.flash("ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT", succes = false)
                onConnexion("")
            }
        }
    }

     // help message parameters for ET password errors
    val paramsPassword = mapOf("min" to MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN) + envoi.params
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp)) {

            typeContenu = ContentType.NewUsername,
        )
        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL",
            secret = true,
            longueurMax = 72,
            valeur = saisie.getValue("password"),
            onChange = { modifier("password", it) },
            erreur = envoi.erreurs["password"],
            params = paramsPassword,
            aide = "INSCRIPTION.PASSWORD_HELP",
            typeContenu = ContentType.NewPassword,

        ChampSaisie(
            libelle = "COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL",

            longueurMax = 72,

@Composable
private fun Suppression() {
    val d = LocalDependances.current
    val envoi = remember { EnvoiFormulaire(d.messages) }
    val confirmation = rememberConfirmation(d.messages)
    val portee = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var motDePasseActuel by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

    fun supprimer() {
        portee.launch {
            if (!confirmation.confirmer("MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM")) return@launch
            val reussi = envoi.envoyer { d.api.supprimerMonCompte(motDePasseActuel) }
            if (reussi) {
                 // the message first: it will be displayed on the login screen,
                 // where navigation takes us as soon as the session is empty
                d.messages.flash("MON_COMPTE.DELETED")
                d.session.oublier(volontaire = true) // The server deleted the token cookie
            }
        }
    }

    OutlinedCard(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFEF9A9A))) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
            Text(t("MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge, color = Color(0xFFC62828))
            Text(t("MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP"), color = Color.Gray)
            ChampSaisie(

                secret = true,

docs.title: 9. Communicating with the server
docs.text: The RdvMedecins server is running (see the previous chapter, with [CAPTCHA_TEST=test] in its [.env] file for testing). Examples 22 through 25 query it from the phone.

docs.title: 9.0.1. Where is the server?
docs.text:
A web application served by the server itself doesn’t have to ask this question: its requests go to the same origin as the page. A MOBILE application does: it must be given the server’s full address. However, the phone is not the computer running the server:

// =========================================================================
// common/Config.kt - Is OÙ the server JSON? (examples 22–25)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A web application served by the server itself does not have this
// question to ask: its requests are sent to the origin, MÊME, rather than to the
// page. A MOBILE application, however, requires that you provide it with the server’s full address
// of the server. However, the phone is not the computer running the
// server:
//    - "localhost" for the phone (or emulator) is LUI-MÊME. The
//      comma nd adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8 080 corrects this: it connects the
//      phone’s port 8080 to the computer’s port 8080 via the USB
//      (or, for the emulator, directly). This is the solution chosen by
//      by default: http://localhost:8080;
//    - the Android emulator also sees the computer at the special address
//     10.0.2.2 ;
//    - a real phone, connected to the same Wi-Fi network as the computer, can
//      use the computer’s address on that network (192.168.1.20...).
// The address is set to COMPILATION (BuildConfig, see app/build.gradle.kts):
//      gradlew installDebug -server=http://10.0.2.2:8080
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.exemples.commun

import fr.stahe.exemples.BuildConfig

object Config {
    val urlServeur: String = BuildConfig.URL_SERVEUR
}
  • “localhost,” for the phone (or emulator), is LUI-MÊME. The command [adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080] connects port 8080 on the phone to port 8080 on the computer via the USB cable (or directly, for the emulator). This is the default solution: [http://localhost:8080]. The command must be rerun each time the emulator is started;
  • the emulator also sees the computer at the special address [10.0.2.2];
  • a real phone connected to the same Wi-Fi network as the computer can use the computer’s address on that network ([192.168.1.20]...), provided that the computer’s firewall allows traffic through port 8080.

The address is a field of the [BuildConfig] class, generated at compile time (see [app/build.gradle.kts], Example 01); it can be changed without modifying the code:

gradlew installDebug -Pserveur=http://10.0.2.2:8080

Finally, the manifest requests permission [INTERNET] and allows “unencrypted” traffic HTTP ([usesCleartextTraffic]): Starting with [Android] 9, only HTTPS is allowed by default.

docs.title: 9.1. Example 22: An initial request HTTP
docs.text:
A CAPTCHA is requested from the server: [GET /api/captcha] returns [[ "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" ]]. The client HTTP is [OkHttp], the most commonly used on [Android] (the equivalent of the [http] packet from [Flutter]).

// =========================================================================
// ex22/Ex22Activity.kt - an initial request HTTP to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server JSON RdvMedecins must be running (port 8080). It is asked to
// a CAPTCHA: GET /api/captcha -> { "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" }.
//
//    - OkHttp, the most widely used client on Android: we describe the
//      request, the client executes it (newCall(...).execute()) and
//      returns the response: its status code (code), its headers
//      (headers), and its body (body);
//    - execute() BLOQUE until the response: Android prohibits calling it
//      on the screen’s execution thread. withContext(Dispatchers.IO)
//      executes it on another thread, and the coroutine ATTEND returns the result;
//    - Json.parseToJsonElement(text): the body JSON -> Kotlin objects;
//    - The server address depends on where the application is running
//      (emulator, phone, etc.): see common/Config.kt;
//    - three states to display: in progress, successful, error;
//    - the CAPTCHA image is from SVG: see commun/ImageSvg.kt.
// =========================================================================
package fr.stahe.exemples.ex22

import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
